text:
Aria: Planning a lean benchmark push: hero image + micro-calculator + webinar. Want a crisp latency vs $/1k tokens story but conveyed simply. Thoughts?
Noah: I'll pull p50/p95 and $/1k for hosted/dedicated/private at seq 64/256/1024. Recommend showing 256 as hero and 64/1024 as skinny inset bars.
Ben: Audience split: dev-first social + product/platform webinar. CTA split: Try API (dev) vs Book consult (platform). Use UTMs to route.
Olga: Visual idea: small-multiples showing same axis scales, plus a tiny interactive slider GIF for seq length. Colors: brand-blue, slate, green. Avoid tiny labels.
Zoe: Add a product note about routing & graceful fallback: show a short callout "auto-fallback keeps p95 stable during spikes." Ops teams care.
Noah: Data note: quantized variants lower $/1k but may move p95. I'll include dashed line for quantized. Export CSV + JSON for the calc.
Aria: Copy options: "Predictable latency. Predictable spend." and "Latency you can count on, costs you can forecast." Which is better?
Ben: First for enterprise, second for social. Short CTA: "See benchmark & calc" and "Request capacity consult".
Olga: Deliverables: hero 1200x628, social 800x800, slide 1200x1600. Also a small downloadable CSV link on landing.
Noah: Deliver CSV+JSON by tomorrow AM. I'll add footnote: "Based on benchmarked configs; see raw data."
Ben: Lead routing: utm_campaign=bench_push, utm_content=headlineA/B. A/B headline test for 48 hours. Track form hidden field for company size.
Zoe: Webinar outline: 20m demo (routing + quantization tradeoffs), 10m bench walkthrough, 10m customer Q&A. Keep under 45m.
alert-bot: Reminder: "Bench Launch Review" scheduled tomorrow 11:00.
Aria: Cool. Action items summarized: @Noah data exports, @Olga mockups, @Ben landing + UTMs + email cadence, @Zoe webinar deck. Will assemble and review midday Friday. Flag risky claims in-thread. :rocket:
